diagnosis.verdict: Nothing feeds marmot-pg.public.asset_terms in this catalog, so there is no upstream chain to blame. If it looks wrong, the cause is in whatever writes it or in the thing reading it.
diagnosis.freshness: No hop in this chain measures its own delay, so there is no end-to-end figure. Consumer lag is the only latency this project captures, and there is no Kafka hop here to read it from.
diagnosis.boundary: The walk stops where Aiven can see: the last hop inside the platform. Whatever reads the end of this chain — a dashboard, a job, somebody's notebook — is invisible here, and is where a symptom nothing upstream explains usually turns out to live.

policy.because: Standard means an outage degrades a tool rather than a pipeline. Maintenance can go in unattended, since the alternative is Aiven applying it at its own deadline anyway.
